expectedRealization.rationale: Coal scarcity can raise miner earnings quickly, but by Sep27 the entire basket had already undergone an extreme rerating.

changeHypothesis.summary: China's power crunch and record coal prices shifted the profit pool sharply toward coal miners. 中国神华 had a low-cost, stable earnings path and low forward PE, but by Sep27 the stock had already outperformed CSI300 by ~54pp over 20d and ~79pp over 60d, while higher-beta peers had rerated even more. The new scarcity news therefore arrived after a major price move.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Coal supply constraints can persist, but policy intervention and generator distress can cap prices.
disconfirmingEvidence: 神华 20/60d relative gains were already extreme.
兖矿 60d excess exceeded +557pp, showing sector-wide speculation/absorption.
The Aug29 forecast already expected 2021/22/23 profit RMB49.7/50.3/50.7bn with only low outer-year growth.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: Power rationing and coal scarcity were headline news; all frozen coal names had strongly outperformed, with 神华 +54pp 20d/+79pp 60d and 兖矿 +558pp 60d versus CSI300.
expectations.thesisExpectation: Scarcity keeps coal earnings above the already-stable Aug baseline for longer.
expectations.measurableGap: The missing evidence is whether later normalized earnings rise enough to offset the extraordinary price rerating and likely policy response.

expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: Scarcity lifts 2022-23 normalized earnings materially above the flat baseline despite policy response.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: Outer-year earnings must rise enough to compensate for a stock already sharply repriced.
